It must be shown by operation tests that, when the controls are operated from the pilot compartment with the system loaded to correspond to 80 percent of the limit load specified for the system, the system is free from--
(a) Jamming;
(b) Excessive friction; and
(c) Excessive deflection.

[It must be shown by operation tests that when portions of the control system subject to pilot effort loads are loaded to 80 percent of the limit load specified for the system and the powered portions of the control system are loaded to the maximum load expected in normal operation, the system is free from--]
(a) Jamming;
(b) Excessive friction; and
(c) Excessive deflection.
